main.description: Kyumei (究明) signal collected from adherent activity. Consumed by KarmaHegemonObservationCell on levi per ADR-2605215200 §1.

adherentDid.description: DID of the adherent whose activity generated this kyumei signal.

signalKind.description: Category of adherent activity that generated this signal.

weight.description: Signal strength in permille (0–1000) where 1000 = maximum weight.

recordedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this signal was recorded.

evidenceCid.description: IPFS CID of the evidence record that generated this signal.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about this kyumei signal.
